globalAliases.warning: The literal source binds Qs to the life-mage fountain skill. Do not silently repair it to A1CF or give every Axisa stage a permanent spell-resistance aura.

completion.operation: Increment the stored integer then request that ability level. No UnitMakeAbilityPermanent in this branch.
completion.firstCompletion: A new handle at any named stage starts the counter at0 and first requests level1. A stage label is not a counter.
completion.outOfRange: The raw completion counter can exceed11; host uses the supported11-level boundary. Original out-of-range SetUnitAbilityLevel behavior is not established.

paths: research/train finishes that explicitly invoke EggWhiteEx
dispatch.boundary: A1CF increment is not gated by the Yt construction boolean inside EggWhiteEx. The Web current completion journal covers supported completed building actions; it does not reconstruct all historical original handles.

deployment.operation: If building Pf has A1CF, SetUnitAbilityLevel on the already-existing combat skill to its building level. This call does not add a missing skill.

levelRules.regenerationMode: Host applies known DataB as flat HP/s using the base AUau DataC=0 reference. The original map omitted DataC; custom inherited flags are not independently proven. In this host levels10 and11 each grant10HP/s.
levelRules.legacyRestore: Recover only exact buildingId journal entries with A1CF-bearing rawcodes; do not infer unseen stages from name/heroLevel. Preserve explicit saved levels/counters, never replay completion during restore. Repeated same-stage events absent from a legacy deduplicated journal cannot be recovered.
levelRules.handleBoundary: The eleven Web stage links are a reconstruction from contiguous Mk/Ml mappings; native Upgrade/Requires data are absent. Web same-buildingId continuity does not prove original Warcraft upgrade versus replacement handle continuity.

normal.flow: Hide building, create mapped combat unit, set userData, then PassiveSkill(Bc,x,Pf).

arena.flow: Create mapped combat unit; PassiveSkillJJC(Pf,Bc) runs before the normal PassiveSkill. The explicit arena pass removes A1UN, and wrapper removes A17L/A1Q4; it does not remove A1CF/CH/CI/CJ/CG/CK.

withinPassiveSkill.flow: If Pf has Qs/A1CU: request its level on Bc, register AxisaHalo immediately (Qt grant plus0-second and1-second timers). If Pf has A1CJ: queue AxisaSwap at0. If Pf has A1OC: queue VashjSwap at0. Copy A1CF near the end. Timer callbacks run later; registration order is preserved by host.

deploymentAndArena.entry: h0U3 is on the hero page at29248, subject to LimitHeroTypeCount and existing hero rules. Existing direct hero upgrades remain; no new troop-training prerequisite. Level11 h0U2 has an explicit select edge to n07I at2597–2598, beyond this eleven-stage audit.

registration.gatedBy: building Pf has Qs=A1CU in PassiveSkill
registration.selfGrant: Add permanent Qt=A1CG to Bc, then request GetUnitAbilityLevel(Bc,Qs). Missing Bc Qs is not implicitly added.
registration.timers: 0-second one-shot and1-second repeat, plus EVENT_WIDGET_DEATH registration on Bc.

pulse.selection: SelectRangeAlly around current caster position within600: ally, not UNIT_TYPE_DEAD, GetUnitAbilityLevel(Avul)==0. Then require existing buff B07T and D6!=caster.
pulse.grant: Only when recipient Qt level==0: add/permanently retain Qt and request current caster Qs level. Existing Qt is not refreshed or upgraded.
pulse.duration: Permanent ability remains when recipient leaves radius, loses B07T or source dies. Widget death destroys the grant trigger, not previously granted recipient abilities.

haloRules.buffBoundary: B07T is an aura buff, not an A1CF ownership check. Host may observe an explicit active buff or reconstruct current aura coverage; exact native aura propagation, lingering/dispel behavior and same-frame refresh timing remain partial.
haloRules.damageScope: A1CG is native AIsr DataB spell reduction, not generic all-damage reduction or magic weapon reduction. Universal script damage remains excluded. Mixed AIsr abilities and other native resistance stacking have not been proven for this map.

legacyMigration.operation: Only a legacy status-only value within tolerance of0.1 becomes an actual permanent A1CG level1. Preserve explicit saved ability levels. Existing modern ability removal does not re-create Qt.
legacyMigration.unknownPercentages: Other positive old values are preserved as nagaResistanceLegacyUnresolved evidence; no A1CG is created and no level is inferred. Actual A19A/A1Q5 overlap decisions read current Qt presence and positive level, so unknown stale percentages cannot suppress their real mitigation.
legacyMigration.reviewFix: Initial migration accepted any positive percentage and changed0.3/0.7 into0.1 with Qt1. Independent snapshot reproduction identified this, then root constrained migration and added actual damage checks.

haloRules.zeroLevelGrantRequest: Registration/grants explicitly record requestedLevel/effectiveLevel and a nonpositiveRequestUnverified flag. A building carrying A1CU does not inject missing combat A1CU; UnitAddAbility(Qt) happens before the unresolved level0 write, and the host preserves its current valid/default level.

axisa.timing: One0-second timer at deployment, no ongoing queen proximity listener.
axisa.enumeration: All units of exact rawcode h0OV across the map. No range, alive, battleTeam, hidden, illusion or once-per-team filters in the source loop.
axisa.ally: UnitAddAbility(A1CK), UnitMakeAbilityPermanent; no SetUnitAbilityLevel. If absent, new default level1 gives host+10%self attack. If already present its current level remains.
axisa.enemy: For every enemy queen separately request current Qt level minus1. There is no call to remove Qt and no A1CK penalty or A1OE addition.
axisa.zeroOrNegative: Native SetUnitAbilityLevel on missing Qt or level<=0 is unverified. Host must record the request and preserve an existing valid ability rather than deleting it.

vashjComparison.enemy: A1CK absent→3,2→4, plus permanent A1OE if absent.
vashjComparison.note: These2/3/4 state transitions are exclusive to VashjSwap; do not reuse them for AxisaSwap.

A1CF.known: DataB level1..11 only; levels5..11 override values recorded.
A1CF.hostBoundary: Reuse known radius/target/buff group for higher supported levels and flat regen; native inheritance remains partial.

A1CH.hostBoundary: 13%damage adapter with both explicit attack-category flags. Base Aakb D0 supports percent interpretation but is not map runtime proof.

A1CI.hostBoundary: Host adds2flat armor; base AHad B0 is reference only.

A1CK.hostBoundary: Self-only aura, not nearby allied attack bonus. Current valid ability level determines its known damage value.

auraSemantics.stacking: B07T/U/V/W are separate buff groups. Multiple copies of the same group use the host strongest-group policy rather than adding all copies; distinct groups contribute independently. Native equal/mixed aura arbitration and linger timing remain partial.
auraSemantics.nativeHeroClassification: Family unit Primary fields are underscore; Web hero altar classification is separate from native UNIT_TYPE_HERO tests.

nativeReferences.scope: 1.31.1 field-name declarations, not this map patch/default inheritance.
Flat regen mode reference only. The table also has movement bonuses; those absent custom fields are not silently imported.
Flat armor mode reference only; no other default values imported.
Both attack categories and percent attack mode reference, not map runtime validation.

boundaries: A1CF level10 and11 each have explicit DataB value10; no invented11HP/s or10/11-level A1CG grants from the named hero stage.
Do not repair Qs=A1CU to A1CF. Ordinary Axisa carries A1CF and therefore does not by itself register the permanent-resistance grant trigger.
Qt decrement requests reaching0/negative are not evidence of ability removal. Previously accepted valid levels remain until native behavior is independently established.
Source original-handle continuity, completion counts beyond supported ability levels, legacy repeated-stage histories and missing ability rewrites remain unrecoverable.
Native buff application/linger/dispel, same-frame0-second callback ordering, widget death vs ordinary death, hidden/removed handles and complete world enumeration remain partial host adapters.
Missing aura percent/flat flags, movement speed, higher-level radius/targets and cross-ability resistance stacking are not established by tooltip or base-reference agreement.
Tests and browser QA, when recorded, validate the Web host only; they are not original Warcraft runtime captures.
